verses.19:1: Now in the third month of the departure of the sons of Israel from the land of Egypt, on this day they came into the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.19:2: And they departed from Rephidim and came into the wilderness of Sinai, and Israel encamped there opposite the mountain.
verses.19:3: And Moses went up to the mountain of God; and God called him from heaven, saying, "Thus you shall say to the house of Jacob and declare to the sons of Israel:
verses.19:4: 'You yourselves have seen all that I have done to the Egyptians, and I took you up as on wings of eagles, and brought you to Myself.
verses.19:5: And now if you truly listen to My voice and keep My covenant, you shall be to Me a treasured people from among all the nations; for all the earth is Mine,
verses.19:6: and you shall be to Me a royal priesthood and a holy nation.' These are the words that you shall speak to the sons of Israel."
verses.19:7: And Moses came and spoke to the elders of the people, and set before them all these words which God had commanded him.
verses.19:8: And all the people answered with one accord and said, "All that God has spoken we will do and we will listen." And Moses brought these words back to God.
verses.19:9: And the Lord said to Moses, "Look, I am coming to you in a pillar of cloud, so that the people may hear as I speak to you, and may believe you forever." And Moses reported the words of the people to the Lord.
verses.19:10: And the Lord said to Moses, "Go down and solemnly charge the people, and purify them today and tomorrow; and let them wash their garments,
verses.19:11: and let them be ready for the third day; for on the third day the Lord will come down upon Mount Sinai before all the people.
verses.19:12: And you shall mark off the people all around, saying, 'Guard yourselves against going up onto the mountain or touching any part of it; everyone who touches the mountain shall surely die.
verses.19:13: No hand shall touch him; for with stones he shall be stoned or with a dart he shall be shot down; whether beast or man, he shall not live.' When the sounds and the trumpets and the cloud depart from the mountain, they shall go up onto the mountain."
verses.19:14: And Moses went down from the mountain to the people, and sanctified them; and they washed their garments.
verses.19:15: And he said to the people, "Be ready for three days; do not come near a woman."
verses.19:16: And it happened on the third day, as it grew toward dawn, that there were sounds and flashes of lightning and a dark cloud upon Mount Sinai, and the sound of the trumpet resounded loudly; and all the people who were in the camp were terrified.
verses.19:17: And Moses brought the people out of the camp to meet God, and they stood at the foot of Mount Sinai.
verses.19:18: And Mount Sinai was smoking entirely because God had come down upon it in fire, and the smoke went up like the smoke of a furnace; and all the people were exceedingly amazed.
verses.19:19: And the sounds of the trumpet went on growing exceedingly stronger; Moses spoke, and God answered him with a voice.
verses.19:20: And the Lord came down upon Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain; and the Lord called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.
verses.19:21: And God spoke to Moses, saying, "Go down and solemnly charge the people, so that they do not draw near to God to observe, and a multitude of them fall;
verses.19:22: and let the priests who draw near to the Lord God be sanctified, so that the Lord does not depart from them."
verses.19:23: And Moses said to God, "The people will not be able to go up onto Mount Sinai; for You have solemnly charged us, saying, 'Mark off the mountain and sanctify it.'"
verses.19:24: And the Lord said to him, "Go, go down, and come up, you and Aaron with you; but let not the priests and the people force their way to come up to God, so that the Lord does not destroy some of them."
verses.19:25: And Moses went down to the people and spoke to them.
verses.20:1: And the Lord spoke all these words, saying,
verses.20:2: "I am the Lord your God, who led you out from the land of Egypt, from a house of slavery.
verses.20:3: You must not have other gods besides Me.
verses.20:4: You must not make for yourself an idol, nor a likeness of anything—whatever is in heaven above, and whatever is on the earth below, and whatever is in the waters beneath the earth.
verses.20:5: You must not bow down to them nor ever serve them, for I am the Lord your God, a jealous God, repaying the sins of fathers upon children to the third and fourth generation for those who hate Me,
verses.20:6: and showing mercy to thousands for those who love Me and for those who keep My commands.
verses.20:7: You must not take the name of the Lord your God in vain, for the Lord your God will by no means clear the one who takes His name in vain.
verses.20:8: Remember the Sabbath day, to sanctify it.
verses.20:9: Six days you will labor and do all your work,
verses.20:10: but on the seventh day is a Sabbath to the Lord your God. You must not do any work on it—you, and your son, and your daughter, your male servant and your female servant, your ox and your beast of burden and all your livestock, and the resident alien who resides among you.
verses.20:11: For in six days the Lord made heaven and earth and all the things in them, and rested on the seventh day. For this reason the Lord blessed the seventh day and sanctified it.
verses.20:12: Honor your father and mother, so that it may go well with you and so that you may live long upon the good land that the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.20:16: You must not testify falsely against your neighbor with false testimony.
verses.20:17: You must not covet your neighbor's wife; you must not covet your neighbor's house, nor his field, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, nor his ox, nor his beast of burden, nor any of his livestock, nor anything that belongs to your neighbor."
verses.20:18: And all the people were seeing the voice and the flashes and the sound of the trumpet and the smoking mountain; and having become afraid, all the people stood at a distance,
verses.20:19: and they said to Moses, "You speak to us, and let God not speak to us, so that we do not die."
verses.20:20: And Moses said to them, "Take courage, for God has come to you in order to test you, so that the fear of Him may be in you, so that you do not sin."
verses.20:21: So the people stood at a distance, while Moses entered into the thick darkness where God was.
verses.20:22: Then the Lord said to Moses, "This is what you will say to the house of Jacob and announce to the sons of Israel: 'You yourselves have seen that from heaven I have spoken to you.
verses.20:23: You must not make for yourselves gods of silver, and gods of gold you must not make for yourselves.
verses.20:24: You will make an altar of earth for Me, and you will sacrifice upon it your whole burnt offerings and your deliverance offerings, your sheep and your calves, in every place where I name My name; and I will come to you and bless you.
verses.20:25: And if you make an altar of stones for Me, you must not build them as cut stones, for you have laid your hand tool upon them, and they have been defiled.
verses.20:26: You must not go up by steps onto My altar, so that you may not uncover your indecency upon it.'"
verses.21:1: And these are the ordinances that you will set before them:
verses.21:2: If you acquire a Hebrew servant, he will serve you for six years, and in the seventh year he will depart free, without payment.
verses.21:3: If he comes in alone, he will also go out alone; but if a wife comes in with him, the wife will also go out with him.
verses.21:4: But if the master gives him a wife, and she bears him sons or daughters, the wife and the children will belong to his master, and he himself will go out alone.
verses.21:5: But if the servant answers and says, "I love my master and my wife and the children; I will not go away free,"
verses.21:6: his master will bring him to the judgment court of God, and then he will bring him to the door, to the doorpost, and his master will pierce his ear with the awl, and he will serve him forever.
verses.21:7: And if someone sells his own daughter as a household servant, she will not depart just as the female slaves go away.
verses.21:8: If she does not please her master who betrothed her to himself, he will release her by ransom; but he has no authority to sell her to a foreign nation, because he has broken faith with her.
verses.21:9: And if he betroths her to his son, he will deal with her according to the ordinance for daughters.
verses.21:10: And if he takes another, he must not withhold the necessities, the clothing, and her marital intimacy.
verses.21:11: And if he does not do these three things for her, she will go out without payment, without money.
verses.21:12: And if someone strikes someone else and he dies, he must surely be put to death.
verses.21:13: But as for the one who did not do it intentionally, rather God delivered him into his hands, I will give you a place to which the one who killed may flee.
verses.21:14: But if someone attacks his neighbor to kill him by treachery and flees for refuge, you will take him from My altar to put him to death.
verses.21:15: Whoever strikes his father or his mother must surely be put to death.
verses.21:16: The one who speaks evil of his father or his mother will surely die.
verses.21:17: Whoever steals someone from the sons of Israel and, having overpowered him, sells him, and he is found with him, must surely die.
verses.21:18: And if two men quarrel and strike their neighbor with a stone or with a fist, and he does not die, but lies down upon his bed,
verses.21:19: if the man gets up and walks about outside on a staff, the one who struck him will be innocent; only he will pay for his loss of work and the medical expenses.
verses.21:20: And if someone strikes his male servant or his female servant with a rod, and the servant dies under his hands, it must be avenged with justice.
verses.21:21: But if the servant survives for one day or two, it will not be avenged, for the servant is his money.
verses.21:22: And if two men fight and strike a pregnant woman, and her child comes out not fully formed, he will surely be fined; according to whatever the woman's husband imposes, he will pay with an assessment.
verses.21:23: But if it was fully formed, he will give life for life,
verses.21:24: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
verses.21:25: burn for burn, wound for wound, bruise for bruise.
verses.21:26: And if someone strikes the eye of his household servant or the eye of his female attendant and blinds it, he will send them away free in place of their eye.
verses.21:27: And if he knocks out the tooth of the household servant or the tooth of his female attendant, he will send them away free in place of their tooth.
verses.21:28: And if a bull gores a man or a woman and the person dies, the bull will be stoned with stones, and its meat must not be eaten; but the owner of the bull will be innocent.
verses.21:29: But if the bull has been a gorer before yesterday and before the third day, and they have warned its owner, and he has not removed it, and it kills a man or a woman, the bull will be stoned, and its owner will also die.
verses.21:30: Yet if a ransom is imposed on him, he will pay as a ransom for his life whatever they impose on him.
verses.21:31: And if it gores a son or a daughter, they will do to him according to this ordinance.
verses.21:32: And if the bull gores a male servant or a female servant, he will pay thirty didrachmas of silver to their master, and the bull will be stoned.
verses.21:33: And if someone opens a pit or quarries one and does not cover it, and a calf or a donkey falls in there,
verses.21:34: the owner of the pit will make restitution; he will pay money to their owner, and the dead animal will belong to him.
verses.21:35: And if someone's bull gores a neighbor's bull and it dies, they will sell the living bull and divide its money, and they will divide the dead bull.
verses.21:36: But if the bull is known to be a gorer before yesterday and before the third day, and they have testified to the owner, and he has not removed it, he will pay back bull for bull, and the dead one will belong to him.
verses.21:37: And if someone steals a calf or a sheep and slaughters or sells it, he will pay back five calves for the calf and four sheep for the sheep.
verses.22:1: Now if the thief is found breaking in and is struck and dies, there is no guilt of murder for him.
verses.22:2: But if the sun has risen upon him, he is guilty; he shall die in return. And if he has nothing, let him be sold in exchange for what was stolen.
verses.22:3: And if what was stolen is caught and found alive in his hand, from a donkey to a sheep, he shall repay them double.
verses.22:4: Now if someone grazes down a field or a vineyard, and lets his animal loose to graze down another field, he shall repay from his own field according to its produce; and if he grazes down the whole field, he shall repay the best of his own field and the best of his own vineyard.
verses.22:5: Now if fire breaks out and catches thorns, and burns up threshing floors or ears of grain or a field, the one who kindled the fire shall repay.
verses.22:6: Now if someone gives his neighbor silver or articles to keep, and it is stolen from the man's house, if the one who stole it is found, he shall repay double.
verses.22:7: But if the one who stole it is not found, the owner of the house shall come before God and shall swear that he himself has certainly not acted wickedly with regard to any of his neighbor's deposit.
verses.22:8: Regarding every stated wrongdoing—whether concerning a calf, a pack animal, a sheep, a garment, or any lost thing that is claimed, whatever it may be—the case of both shall come before God, and the one convicted by God shall repay double to his neighbor.
verses.22:9: Now if someone gives his neighbor a pack animal, or a calf, or a sheep, or any animal to keep, and it is injured, or dies, or is taken captive, and no one knows,
verses.22:10: an oath of God shall be between both of them that he himself has certainly not acted wickedly at all with regard to his neighbor's deposit; and so its owner shall accept it, and he shall not repay.
verses.22:11: But if it is stolen from him, he shall repay the owner.
verses.22:12: And if it is caught by a wild beast, he shall lead him to the prey, and he shall not repay.
verses.22:13: Now if someone borrows from his neighbor, and it is injured, or dies, or is taken captive, and the owner is not with it, he shall repay.
verses.22:14: But if the owner is with it, he shall not repay; and if he is a hired worker, it shall be for him in place of his hire.
verses.22:15: Now if someone seduces an unbetrothed virgin and lies with her, he shall surely pay the bride-price for her to be his wife.
verses.22:16: But if her father utterly refuses and is not willing to give her to him as a wife, he shall repay silver to the father according to the amount of the bride-price of virgins.
verses.22:17: You shall not keep sorcerers alive.
verses.22:18: Anyone who lies with an animal—you shall surely put them to death.
verses.22:19: The one who sacrifices to gods, except to the Lord alone, shall be destroyed by death.
verses.22:20: And you shall not mistreat a resident alien, nor shall you oppress him; for you were resident aliens in the land of Egypt.
verses.22:21: You shall not mistreat any widow or orphan.
verses.22:22: And if you harshly mistreat them, and crying out they cry aloud to Me, I will surely listen to their voice,
verses.22:23: and I will grow furious with anger and will kill you with the sword, and your wives will become widows and your children orphans.
verses.22:24: Now if you lend silver to the poor brother with you, you shall not be pressing him hard; you shall not impose interest upon him.
verses.22:25: And if you indeed take your neighbor's garment as a pledge, you shall return it to him before sunset;
verses.22:26: for this is his covering; this alone is the garment for his nakedness. In what will he sleep? Therefore, if he cries aloud to Me, I will listen to him, for I am merciful.
verses.22:27: You shall not revile gods, and you shall not speak evil of rulers of your people.
verses.22:28: You shall not delay the firstfruits of your threshing floor and winepress; the firstborn of your sons you shall give to Me.
verses.22:29: So you shall do with your calf and your sheep and your pack animal: seven days it shall be under its mother, and on the eighth day you shall give it back to Me.
verses.22:30: And you shall be holy men to Me; and you shall not eat meat caught by a wild beast; throw it away to the dog.
verses.23:1: You shall not accept a vain report; you shall not side with the unjust person to become an unjust witness.
verses.23:2: You shall not be with the majority in wickedness; you shall not join with a crowd to turn aside with the majority, so as to shut out justice.
verses.23:3: And you shall not show pity to a poor person in judgment.
verses.23:4: Now if you encounter your enemy's ox or his pack animal wandering astray, turning it back, you shall return it to him.
verses.23:5: And if you see your enemy's pack animal fallen under its load, you shall not pass by it, but you shall lift it up together with him.
verses.23:6: You shall not pervert the judgment of a poor person in his case.
verses.23:7: From every unjust matter you shall stay away; the innocent and the righteous you shall not kill, and you shall not acquit the ungodly for the sake of gifts.
verses.23:8: And you shall not take gifts; for gifts blind the eyes of those who see and ruin righteous words.
verses.23:9: And you shall not oppress a resident alien; for you know the soul of the resident alien, because you yourselves were resident aliens in the land of Egypt.
verses.23:10: Six years you shall sow your land and gather its produce;
verses.23:11: but in the seventh you shall make a release and let it lie fallow, and the poor of your nation shall eat; and what is left over the wild beasts shall eat. So you shall do with your vineyard and your olive grove.
verses.23:12: Six days you shall do your works, and on the seventh day there shall be rest, so that your ox and your pack animal may rest, and so that the son of your female servant and the resident alien may rest.
verses.23:13: Observe everything that I have spoken to you; and the name of other gods you shall not bring to mind, nor shall it be heard from your mouth.
verses.23:14: Three times of the year you shall celebrate a festival to Me.
verses.23:15: You shall be careful to keep the festival of unleavened bread: seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, just as I commanded you, at the appointed time of the month of new crops, for in it you came out of Egypt. You shall not appear before Me empty-handed.
verses.23:16: And you shall keep the festival of the harvest of the first produce of your labors, of whatever you sow in your field, and the festival of completion at the outgoing of the year, at the gathering in of your labors from your field.
verses.23:17: Three times of the year every male of yours shall appear before the Lord your God.
verses.23:18: For when I cast out nations from before your face and enlarge your borders, you shall not offer the blood of My incense-offering with leaven, nor shall the fat of My festival remain overnight until morning.
verses.23:19: The firstfruits of your first produce you shall bring into the house of the Lord your God. You shall not boil a lamb in its mother's milk.
verses.23:20: And look, I am sending My angel before your face so that he may guard you on the way, in order that he may bring you into the land which I have prepared for you.
verses.23:21: Pay attention to yourself and listen to him, and do not disobey him; for he will by no means hold back from you, for My name is upon him.
verses.23:22: If you truly listen to My voice, and do all things that I command you, and keep My covenant, you shall be to Me a treasured people above all the nations; for all the earth is Mine, and you shall be to Me a royal priesthood and a holy nation. These words you shall speak to the sons of Israel. If you truly listen to My voice, and do all things that I say to you, I will be an enemy to your enemies and oppose those who oppose you.
verses.23:23: For My angel will go leading you, and will bring you to the Amorite and the Hittite and the Perizzite and the Canaanite and the Girgashite and the Hivite and the Jebusite, and I will wipe them out.
verses.23:24: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor shall you serve them; you shall not do according to their works, but you shall utterly tear them down and completely shatter their pillars.
verses.23:25: And you shall serve the Lord your God, and I will bless your bread and your wine and your water, and I will turn sickness away from you.
verses.23:26: There shall not be one childless or barren in your land; I will fill up the number of your days.
verses.23:27: And I will send terror leading ahead of you, and I will throw into panic all the nations among whom you enter, and I will make all your adversaries fugitives.
verses.23:28: And I will send the hornets ahead of you, and you shall drive out the Amorites and the Hivites and the Canaanites and the Hittites away from you.
verses.23:29: I will not drive them out in a single year, so that the land does not become desolate and the wild beasts of the land do not become many against you;
verses.23:30: little by little I will drive them out from you, until you increase and inherit the land.
verses.23:31: And I will set your borders from the Red Sea to the Sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the great river Euphrates; and I will hand over into your hands those who dwell in the land, and I will drive them out from you.
verses.23:32: You shall not make a covenant with them and their gods.
verses.23:33: And they shall not dwell in your land, so that they do not cause you to sin against Me; for if you serve their gods, these will be a stumbling block to you.
verses.24:1: And He said to Moses, "Come up to the Lord, you and Aaron and Nadab and Abihu and seventy of the elders of Israel, and they shall worship the Lord from a distance.
verses.24:2: And Moses alone shall draw near to God, but they shall not draw near; and the people shall not go up with them."
verses.24:3: Then Moses came in and recounted to the people all the words of God and the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice, saying, "All the words that the Lord has spoken we will do and heed."
verses.24:4: And Moses wrote all the words of the Lord. Rising early in the morning, Moses built an altar beneath the mountain and twelve stones for the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.24:5: And he sent out the young men of the sons of Israel, and they offered up whole burnt offerings, and sacrificed young calves as a sacrifice of deliverance to God.
verses.24:6: Taking half of the blood, Moses poured it into bowls; and the other half of the blood he poured out against the altar.
verses.24:7: And taking the book of the covenant, he read it in the ears of the people, and they said, "All that the Lord has spoken we will do and heed."
verses.24:8: Then Moses took the blood, sprinkled it over the people, and said, "Look, the blood of the covenant that the Lord has established with you concerning all these words."
verses.24:9: And Moses and Aaron and Nadab and Abihu and seventy of the council of elders of Israel went up,
verses.24:10: and they saw the place where the God of Israel stood; and what was under His feet was like a work of sapphire brick, and like the appearance of the vault of heaven in clearness.
verses.24:11: And of the chosen ones of Israel not even one perished; and they appeared in the place of God, and they ate and drank.
verses.24:12: And the Lord said to Moses, "Come up to Me on the mountain and remain there; and I will give you the stone tablets, the law and the commandments that I have written to give as law to them."
verses.24:13: And rising up, Moses and Joshua his attendant went up into the mountain of God.
verses.24:14: And to the elders they said, "Remain quietly here until we return to you; and look, Aaron and Hur are with you; if a legal dispute happens to anyone, let them approach them."
verses.24:15: And Moses and Joshua went up into the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.
verses.24:16: And the glory of God descended upon Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it for six days; and the Lord called Moses on the seventh day from the midst of the cloud.
verses.24:17: Now the appearance of the glory of the Lord was like a blazing fire on the summit of the mountain before the sons of Israel.
verses.24:18: And Moses entered into the midst of the cloud and went up into the mountain, and he was there on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
verses.25:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.25:2: "Speak to the sons of Israel, and take firstfruits from all to whom it seems good in their heart; and you shall receive My firstfruits.
verses.25:3: And this is the firstfruit that you shall receive from them: gold and silver and bronze,
verses.25:4: and blue and purple and double-dyed scarlet and spun fine linen and goat hair,
verses.25:5: and ram skins dyed red and blue skins and incorruptible wood,
verses.25:7: and sardius stones and stones for engraving, for the shoulder-garment and the full-length robe.
verses.25:8: And you shall make Me a sanctuary, and I will appear among you;
verses.25:9: and you shall make it for Me according to all that I show you on the mountain, the pattern of the tent and the pattern of all its articles. So you shall make it.
verses.25:10: And you shall make an ark of testimony of incorruptible wood, two and a half cubits in length, and a cubit and a half in width, and a cubit and a half in height.
verses.25:11: And you shall overlay it with pure gold; outside and inside you shall gild it; and you shall make for it twisted golden wave-moldings all around.
verses.25:12: And you shall hammer out for it four golden rings and place them on the four sides: two rings on the one side, and two rings on the second side.
verses.25:13: And you shall make carrying poles of incorruptible wood, and overlay them with gold;
verses.25:14: and you shall insert the carrying poles into the rings that are on the sides of the ark, to carry the ark with them.
verses.25:15: In the rings of the ark the carrying poles shall remain immovable.
verses.25:16: And you shall put into the ark the testimonies that I will give you.
verses.25:17: And you shall make a mercy seat of pure gold, two and a half cubits in length, and a cubit and a half in width.
verses.25:18: And you shall make two cherubim of hammered gold, and place them on both sides of the mercy seat;
verses.25:19: they shall be made one cherub on this side and one cherub on the second side of the mercy seat; and you shall make the two cherubim on the two sides.
verses.25:20: The cherubim shall be stretching out their wings above, overshadowing the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another; toward the mercy seat shall be the faces of the cherubim.
verses.25:21: And you shall place the mercy seat on top of the ark, and into the ark you shall put the testimonies that I will give you.
verses.25:22: And I will make Myself known to you from there, and I will speak to you from above the mercy seat, between the two cherubim that are upon the ark of the testimony, and according to all that I command you for the sons of Israel.
verses.25:23: And you shall make a golden table of pure gold, two cubits in length, and a cubit in breadth, and a cubit and a half in height.
verses.25:24: And you shall make for it twisted golden wave-moldings all around; and you shall make for it a rim of a handbreadth all around;
verses.25:25: and you shall make a twisted wave-molding for the rim all around.
verses.25:26: And you shall make four golden rings, and you shall place the four rings on the four parts of its legs under the rim;
verses.25:27: and the rings shall serve as holders for the carrying poles, so as to carry the table with them.
verses.25:28: And you shall make the carrying poles of incorruptible wood, and overlay them with pure gold, and the table shall be carried with them.
verses.25:29: And you shall make its dishes and the censers and the libation bowls and the ladles with which you will pour drink offerings; of pure gold you shall make them.
verses.25:30: And you shall place on the table loaves of presence before Me continually.
verses.25:31: And you shall make a lampstand of pure gold; of hammered work you shall make the lampstand; its shaft and the branches and the cups and the knobs and the lilies shall be of one piece with it.
verses.25:32: And six branches shall go out from its sides: three branches of the lampstand from its one side, and three branches of the lampstand from the second side.
verses.25:33: And three cups shaped like small nuts, on the one branch a knob and a lily; so for the six branches going out from the lampstand.
verses.25:34: And on the lampstand four cups shaped like small nuts; on the one branch, knobs and its lilies.
verses.25:35: The knob under the two branches shall be of one piece with it, and a knob under the four branches of one piece with it; so for the six branches going out from the lampstand. And on the lampstand four cups shaped like small nuts.
verses.25:36: The knobs and the branches shall be of one piece with it; all of it hammered work, of one piece of pure gold.
verses.25:37: And you shall make its lamps seven; and you shall set up the lamps, and they shall shine from the one front.
verses.25:38: And its oil-pourer and its trays you shall make of pure gold;
verses.25:39: all these articles shall be a talent of pure gold.
verses.25:40: See that you make them according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain."
verses.26:1: And you shall make the tabernacle of ten curtains of twisted fine linen and blue and purple and twisted scarlet; you shall make them with cherubim, the work of a weaver.
verses.26:2: The length of one curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the width of one curtain shall be four cubits; there shall be the same measure for all the curtains.
verses.26:3: And five curtains shall be joined to one another, one to the other, and five curtains shall be joined together, one to the other.
verses.26:4: And you shall make for them blue loops on the edge of the one curtain, on the one side for the joining; and so you shall do on the edge of the outermost curtain at the second joining.
verses.26:5: You shall make fifty loops for the one curtain, and you shall make fifty loops on the side of the curtain at the joining of the second, facing opposite and matching one another, each to each.
verses.26:6: And you shall make fifty gold rings, and you shall join the curtains one to the other with the rings; and the tabernacle shall be one.
verses.26:7: And you shall make cloths of hair as a covering over the tabernacle; you shall make them eleven cloths.
verses.26:8: The length of one cloth shall be thirty cubits, and four cubits shall be the width of one cloth; there shall be the same measure for the eleven cloths.
verses.26:9: And you shall join the five cloths together, and the six cloths together; and you shall fold the sixth cloth double at the front of the tabernacle.
verses.26:10: And you shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one cloth that is in the middle at the joining, and you shall make fifty loops on the edge of the second joining cloth.
verses.26:11: And you shall make fifty bronze rings, and you shall join the rings to the loops, and you shall join the cloths, and it shall be one.
verses.26:12: And you shall place underneath what is left over in the cloths of the tabernacle; you shall cover underneath behind the tabernacle.
verses.26:13: A cubit on this side and a cubit on that side, from what extends beyond of the cloths, from the length of the cloths of the tabernacle, shall cover over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, so that it may cover.
verses.26:14: And you shall make a covering for the tabernacle of rams' skins dyed red, and top coverings of blue skins above.
verses.26:15: And you shall make pillars for the tabernacle of incorruptible wood.
verses.26:16: Ten cubits you shall make the one pillar, and one and a half cubits shall be the breadth of the one pillar.
verses.26:17: There shall be two tenons for the one pillar, matching one to the other; so you shall do for all the pillars of the tabernacle.
verses.26:18: And you shall make pillars for the tabernacle, twenty pillars on the side toward the north.
verses.26:19: And you shall make forty silver bases for the twenty pillars, two bases for the one pillar for both of its sides.
verses.26:20: And for the second side, toward the south, twenty pillars,
verses.26:21: and their forty silver bases, two bases for the one pillar for both of its sides.
verses.26:22: And at the back of the tabernacle, on the side toward the sea, you shall make six pillars.
verses.26:23: And you shall make two pillars at the corners of the tabernacle at the back,
verses.26:24: and it shall be equal at the bottom; in the same way they shall be equal at their heads into one joining; so you shall do for both; let them be for the two corners.
verses.26:25: And there shall be eight pillars, and their bases shall be sixteen silver ones: two bases for the one pillar for both of its sides, and two bases for the other pillar.
verses.26:26: And you shall make bars of incorruptible wood, five for the one pillar on the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.26:27: and five bars for the one pillar on the second side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the rear pillar on the side of the tabernacle toward the sea.
verses.26:28: And let the middle bar in the midst of the pillars reach through from the one side to the other side.
verses.26:29: And you shall overlay the pillars with gold, and you shall make the rings of gold into which you shall insert the bars, and you shall overlay the bars with gold.
verses.26:30: And you shall erect the tabernacle according to the form that was shown to you on the mountain.
verses.26:31: And you shall make a veil of blue and purple and twisted scarlet and spun fine linen; you shall make it a woven work with cherubim.
verses.26:32: And you shall put it upon four incorruptible pillars overlaid with gold; and their capitals shall be of gold, and their four bases shall be of silver.
verses.26:33: And you shall place the veil upon the pillars, and you shall bring in there, inside the veil, the ark of the testimony; and the veil shall separate for you between the holy place and the Holy of Holies.
verses.26:34: And you shall cover the ark of the testimony with the veil in the Holy of Holies.
verses.26:35: And you shall place the table outside the veil, and the lampstand opposite the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south; and the table you shall put on the side of the tabernacle toward the north.
verses.26:36: And you shall make a screen of blue and purple and twisted scarlet and twisted fine linen, the work of an embroiderer.
verses.26:37: And you shall make five pillars for the veil, and you shall overlay them with gold; and their capitals shall be of gold; and you shall cast five bronze bases for them.
verses.27:1: And you shall make an altar of incorruptible wood, five cubits in length and five cubits in width; the altar shall be square, and its height shall be three cubits.
verses.27:2: And you shall make the horns on the four corners; the horns shall be part of it, and you shall cover them with bronze.
verses.27:3: And you shall make a rim for the altar, and its cover, and its bowls, and its meat forks, and its firepan; and all its utensils you shall make of bronze.
verses.27:4: And you shall make for it a bronze grate of network, and you shall make for the grate four bronze rings under the four sides.
verses.27:5: And you shall place them under the grate of the altar below; and the grate shall extend to halfway up the altar.
verses.27:6: And you shall make carrying poles for the altar of incorruptible wood, and you shall overlay them with bronze.
verses.27:7: And you shall insert the carrying poles into the rings, and let the carrying poles be along the sides of the altar when carrying it.
verses.27:8: You shall make it hollow with boards; according to what was shown to you on the mountain, so you shall make it.
verses.27:9: And you shall make a courtyard for the tabernacle; on the side toward the southwest there shall be hangings for the courtyard, a length of one hundred cubits for the one side.
verses.27:10: And their pillars shall be twenty, and their bases twenty of bronze, and their rings and the bands shall be of silver.
verses.27:11: Likewise on the side toward the east, hangings of one hundred cubits in length; and their pillars shall be twenty, and their bases twenty of bronze, and the rings and the bands of the pillars and their bases shall be overlaid with silver.
verses.27:12: And for the width of the courtyard toward the sea, hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars shall be ten, and their bases ten.
verses.27:13: And for the width of the courtyard toward the south, hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars shall be ten, and their bases ten.
verses.27:14: And fifteen cubits shall be the height of the hangings for the one side; their pillars shall be three, and their bases three.
verses.27:15: And for the second side, fifteen cubits shall be the height of the hangings; their pillars shall be three, and their bases three.
verses.27:16: And for the gate of the courtyard there shall be a covering, twenty cubits in height, of blue and purple and twisted scarlet and twisted fine linen with the embroidery of a needleworker; their pillars shall be four, and their bases four.
verses.27:17: All the pillars of the courtyard all around shall be overlaid with silver, and their capitals shall be of silver, and their bases of bronze.
verses.27:18: And the length of the courtyard shall be one hundred by one hundred, and the width fifty by fifty, and the height five cubits, of twisted fine linen, and their bases of bronze.
verses.27:19: And all the equipment and all the implements and the pegs of the courtyard shall be of bronze.
verses.27:20: And you, command the sons of Israel, and let them take for you oil from olives, clear, pure, beaten, to burn for light, so that a lamp may burn continually
verses.27:21: in the tabernacle of the testimony, outside the veil that is over the covenant; Aaron and his sons shall burn it from evening until morning before the Lord. It shall be a perpetual statute for your generations from the sons of Israel.
verses.28:1: And you, bring near to yourself both Aaron your brother and his sons from among the sons of Israel to serve as priests to Me: Aaron, and Nadab and Abihu and Eleazar and Ithamar, sons of Aaron.
verses.28:2: And you shall make a holy garment for Aaron your brother, for honor and glory.
verses.28:3: And you, speak to all who are wise in mind, whom I have filled with a spirit of perception, and they shall make the holy garment of Aaron for the sanctuary, in which he shall serve as priest to Me.
verses.28:4: And these are the garments which they shall make: the breastpiece and the shoulder-garment and the full-length tasseled tunic and a turban and a sash. And they shall make holy garments for Aaron and for his sons to serve as priests to Me.
verses.28:5: And they shall take the gold and the blue and the purple and the scarlet and the fine linen.
verses.28:6: And they shall make the shoulder-garment of twisted fine linen, the work of an embroidering weaver.
verses.28:7: Two shoulder-pieces joining one to the other shall be on it, fitted on the two sides;
verses.28:8: and the woven work of the shoulder-pieces, which is upon it, according to its workmanship shall be of one piece with it, of gold and blue and purple and spun scarlet and twisted fine linen.
verses.28:9: And you shall take the two stones, stones of emerald, and you shall engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel:
verses.28:10: six names on the one stone, and the remaining six names on the second stone, according to their births,
verses.28:11: the work of a stone-carving craft; as the engraving of a seal you shall engrave the two stones upon
verses.28:12: the shoulders of the shoulder-garment. They are stones of remembrance for the sons of Israel; and Aaron shall carry the names of the sons of Israel before the Lord upon his two shoulders, a remembrance concerning them.
verses.28:13: And you shall make small shields of pure gold;
verses.28:14: and you shall make two fringes of pure gold, intermingled with flowers, the work of braiding; and you shall place the braided fringes upon the small shields along their shoulder-edges on the front.
verses.28:15: And you shall make an oracle of judgments, the work of an embroiderer; according to the pattern of the shoulder-garment you shall make it; of gold and blue and purple and twisted scarlet and twisted fine linen
verses.28:16: you shall make it. It shall be square, doubled; a span its length and a span its width.
verses.28:17: And you shall weave into it a four-rowed woven work set with stones. There shall be a row of stones: sardius, topaz, and emerald, the first row;
verses.28:18: and the second row, carbuncle and sapphire and jasper;
verses.28:19: and the third row, ligure, agate, amethyst;
verses.28:20: and the fourth row, chrysolite and beryl and onyx; covered around with gold, bound together in gold, let them be according to their row.
verses.28:21: And let the stones be twelve from the names of the sons of Israel, according to their names; engravings of seals, each according to the name, let them be for twelve tribes.
verses.28:22: And you shall make on the oracle intertwined fringes, chain-work of pure gold.
verses.28:29: And Aaron shall take the names of the sons of Israel upon the oracle of judgment on his chest, when entering into the sanctuary, a remembrance before God. And you shall put the fringes on the oracle of judgment; the chains you shall place on both sides of the oracle, and the two small shields you shall place on both shoulders of the shoulder-garment in front.
verses.28:30: And you shall place upon the oracle of judgment the manifestation and the truth; and it shall be upon the chest of Aaron whenever he enters into the sanctuary before the Lord; and Aaron shall bear the judgments of the sons of Israel upon his chest before the Lord continually.
verses.28:31: And you shall make a full-length under-robe, entirely of blue.
verses.28:32: And the neck-opening shall be in the middle of it, having a border around the neck-opening, the work of a weaver, the seam woven together from it, so that it may not tear.
verses.28:33: And you shall make under the hem of the under-robe below, as of a blossoming pomegranate, small pomegranates of blue and purple and spun scarlet and twisted fine linen, upon the hem of the under-robe all around; in the same form, small gold pomegranates, and bells in between them all around;
verses.28:34: next to a small gold pomegranate, a bell and a floral ornament upon the hem of the under-robe all around.
verses.28:35: And for Aaron while ministering, its sound shall be audible as he enters into the sanctuary before the Lord and as he goes out, so that he may not die.
verses.28:36: And you shall make a plate of pure gold, and you shall stamp on it the impression of a seal: "Holiness of the Lord."
verses.28:37: And you shall place it upon twisted blue, and it shall be upon the miter; on the front of the miter it shall be.
verses.28:38: And it shall be upon the forehead of Aaron, and Aaron shall take away the sins of the holy things, whatever the sons of Israel may consecrate, of every gift of their holy things; and it shall be upon the forehead of Aaron continually, acceptable for them before the Lord.
verses.28:39: And the tasseled parts of the tunics shall be of fine linen; and you shall make a turban of fine linen, and you shall make a sash, the work of an embroiderer.
verses.28:40: And for the sons of Aaron you shall make tunics and sashes, and turbans you shall make for them, for honor and glory.
verses.28:41: And you shall put them on Aaron your brother and his sons with him; and you shall anoint them, and you shall fill their hands, and you shall consecrate them, so that they may serve as priests to Me.
verses.28:42: And you shall make for them linen breeches to cover the nakedness of their flesh; from waist to thighs they shall be.
verses.28:43: And Aaron and his sons shall wear them whenever they enter into the tent of the testimony, when they approach to minister at the altar of the sanctuary; and they shall not bring sin upon themselves, so that they may not die; an eternal statute for him and for his seed after him.
verses.29:1: And these are the things that you shall do for them: you shall sanctify them so that they may serve as priests to Me. You shall take one young calf from the cattle and two unblemished rams,
verses.29:2: and unleavened loaves mixed with oil, and unleavened flatbreads spread with oil; you shall make them of fine flour from wheat.
verses.29:3: And you shall place them in one basket. And you shall present them in the basket, and the young calf and the two rams.
verses.29:4: And you shall bring Aaron and his sons to the doors of the tent of the testimony, and you shall wash them with water.
verses.29:5: And taking the robes, you shall clothe Aaron your brother with the full-length tunic and the shoulder garment and the oracle piece against the shoulder garment.
verses.29:6: And you shall put the turban on his head, and you shall place the holy plate on the turban.
verses.29:7: And you shall take some of the anointing oil and pour it on his head, and you shall anoint him.
verses.29:8: And you shall bring his sons forward, and you shall clothe them with tunics.
verses.29:9: And you shall bind them with the sashes, and you shall put the caps on them; and the priesthood to Me shall be theirs forever. And you shall consecrate the hands of Aaron and the hands of his sons.
verses.29:10: And you shall bring the calf to the doors of the tent of the testimony, and Aaron and his sons shall place their hands on the head of the calf before the Lord beside the doors of the tent of the testimony.
verses.29:11: And you shall slaughter the calf before the Lord beside the doors of the tent of the testimony.
verses.29:12: And you shall take some of the blood of the calf and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger; and all the remaining blood you shall pour out beside the base of the altar.
verses.29:13: And you shall take all the fat that is on the belly, and the lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, and you shall place them on the altar.
verses.29:14: But the flesh of the calf and the hide and the dung you shall burn up with fire outside the camp; for it is a sin offering.
verses.29:15: And you shall take the one ram, and Aaron and his sons shall place their hands on the head of the ram.
verses.29:16: And you shall slaughter it, and taking the blood, you shall pour it against the altar all around.
verses.29:17: And you shall cut the ram into pieces according to its parts, and you shall wash the entrails and the feet with water, and you shall place the cut pieces together with the head.
verses.29:18: And you shall offer up the whole ram on the altar, a whole burnt offering to the Lord for a fragrant aroma; it shall be an incense offering to the Lord.
verses.29:19: And you shall take the second ram, and Aaron and his sons shall place their hands on the head of the ram.
verses.29:20: And you shall slaughter it, and you shall take some of its blood and place it on the lobe of Aaron's right ear, and on the tip of his right hand, and on the tip of his right foot, and on the lobes of the right ears of his sons, and on the tips of their right hands, and on the tips of their right feet.
verses.29:21: And you shall take some of the blood that is from the altar and some of the anointing oil, and you shall sprinkle it on Aaron and on his robe, and on his sons and on the robes of his sons with him; and he and his robe shall be sanctified, and his sons and the robes of his sons with him; and the blood of the ram you shall pour against the altar all around.
verses.29:22: And you shall take from the ram its fat and the fat that covers the belly, and the lobe of the liver and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, and the right shoulder (for this is a consecration),
verses.29:23: and one loaf made with oil and one flatbread from the basket of the unleavened loaves set before the Lord.
verses.29:24: And you shall place all of them on the hands of Aaron and on the hands of his sons, and you shall set apart for them a separated offering before the Lord.
verses.29:25: And you shall take them from their hands, and you shall offer them up on the altar of the whole burnt offering for a fragrant aroma before the Lord; it is a sacrificial offering to the Lord.
verses.29:26: And you shall take the breast from the ram of consecration that belongs to Aaron, and you shall set it apart as a separated offering before the Lord, and it shall be for you as a portion.
verses.29:27: And you shall sanctify the breast as a separated offering and the shoulder of the contribution, which has been set apart and which has been taken away, from the ram of consecration, from Aaron and from his sons.
verses.29:28: And it shall be for Aaron and his sons an eternal statute from the sons of Israel; for this is a separated offering; and it shall be a contribution from the sons of Israel, from the sacrifices of deliverance of the sons of Israel, a contribution to the Lord.
verses.29:29: And the robe of the sanctuary that belongs to Aaron shall be for his sons after him, for them to be anointed in them and to consecrate their hands.
verses.29:30: For seven days the priest among his sons who is in his place shall put them on, who will enter into the tent of the testimony to minister in the holy places.
verses.29:31: And you shall take the ram of consecration and boil the flesh in a holy place.
verses.29:32: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram and the loaves that are in the basket beside the doors of the tent of the testimony.
verses.29:33: They shall eat those things by which they were sanctified, to consecrate their hands, to sanctify them; and an outsider shall not eat from it, for they are holy.
verses.29:34: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of consecration and of the loaves is left over until morning, you shall burn up the remainder with fire; it shall not be eaten, for it is a holy thing.
verses.29:35: And you shall do in this way to Aaron and to his sons, according to everything that I commanded you; for seven days you shall consecrate their hands.
verses.29:36: And you shall offer the young calf of the sin offering on the day of purification; and you shall purify the altar when you sanctify upon it, and you shall anoint it so as to sanctify it.
verses.29:37: For seven days you shall purify the altar and sanctify it, and the altar shall be most holy; everyone who touches the altar shall be sanctified.
verses.29:38: And these are the things that you shall offer on the altar: two unblemished year-old lambs each day on the altar continually, a continual sacrificial offering.
verses.29:39: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning, and the second lamb you shall offer in the evening,
verses.29:40: and a tenth of fine flour mixed with beaten oil, a fourth of a hin, and a drink offering of a fourth of a hin of wine, for the one lamb.
verses.29:41: And the second lamb you shall offer in the evening; according to the morning sacrifice and according to its drink offering you shall offer it, as a fragrant aroma, a sacrificial offering to the Lord,
verses.29:42: a continual sacrifice throughout your generations, at the doors of the tent of the testimony before the Lord, by which I will be made known to you from there, so as to speak to you.
verses.29:43: And I will give orders there to the sons of Israel, and I will be sanctified in My glory.
verses.29:44: And I will sanctify the tent of the testimony and the altar, and I will sanctify Aaron and his sons to serve as priests to Me.
verses.29:45: And I will be called upon among the sons of Israel, and I will be their God.
verses.29:46: And they shall know that I am the Lord their God, who brought them out from the land of Egypt, to be called upon by them and to be their God.
verses.30:1: "And you shall make an altar of incense from incorruptible wood.
verses.30:2: And you shall make it a cubit in length and a cubit in width—it shall be square—and two cubits in height; its horns shall be from it.
verses.30:3: And you shall overlay them with pure gold—its hearth and its walls all around and its horns—and you shall make for it a twisted gold molding all around.
verses.30:4: And you shall make two pure gold rings under its twisted molding on the two sides; you shall make them on the two flanks, and they shall be holders for the poles so as to carry it with them.
verses.30:5: And you shall make poles from incorruptible wood, and you shall overlay them with gold.
verses.30:6: And you shall place it in front of the veil that is over the ark of the testimonies, in which I will make Myself known to you from there.
verses.30:7: And Aaron shall offer fine compounded incense on it; morning by morning, when he tends the lamps, he shall burn incense on it.
verses.30:8: And when Aaron lights the lamps in the evening, you shall burn incense on it, a continual incense perpetually before the Lord throughout their generations.
verses.30:9: And he shall not offer up on it other incense, an offering by fire, or a sacrifice; you shall not pour out a drink offering on it.
verses.30:10: And Aaron shall make atonement for it on its horns once a year; with the blood of the purification he shall purify it throughout their generations; it is a holy of holies to the Lord."
verses.30:11: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.30:12: "When you take the reckoning of the sons of Israel at their inspection, then each one shall give a ransom for his soul to the Lord, and there shall not be a downfall among them at their inspection.
verses.30:13: And this is what they shall give, as many as pass through the inspection: half of the didrachma, which is according to the sacred didrachma—twenty obols is the didrachma—and the half of the didrachma is a contribution to the Lord.
verses.30:14: Everyone who passes into the inspection from twenty years old and upward, they shall give the contribution to the Lord.
verses.30:15: The one who is rich shall not add and the one who is poor shall not give less than the half of the didrachma, in giving the contribution to the Lord to make atonement for your souls.
verses.30:16: And you shall receive the silver of the contribution from the sons of Israel, and you shall give it for the work of the tent of the testimony; and it shall be to the sons of Israel a memorial before the Lord, and to make atonement for your souls."
verses.30:17: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.30:18: "Make a bronze basin and a bronze base for it, for washing; and you shall place it between the tent of the testimony and the altar, and you shall pour water into it.
verses.30:19: And Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet from it with water.
verses.30:20: Whenever they enter into the tent of the testimony, they shall wash with water and they shall by no means die; whenever they approach the altar to minister and to offer up the whole burnt offerings to the Lord,
verses.30:21: they shall wash their hands and their feet with water; whenever they enter into the tent of the testimony, they shall wash with water so that they may not die; and it shall be to them an eternal statute, to him and to his generations after him."
verses.30:22: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.30:23: "And you, take spices: the flower of choice myrrh, five hundred shekels, and of fragrant cinnamon, half of this, two hundred fifty, and of fragrant calamus, two hundred fifty,
verses.30:24: and of iris, five hundred shekels of the sanctuary, and oil from olives, a hin;
verses.30:25: and you shall make it a holy anointing oil, a perfumed ointment by the craft of a perfumer; it shall be a holy anointing oil.
verses.30:26: And you shall anoint with it the tent of the testimony, and the ark of the testimony,
verses.30:27: and the lampstand and all its utensils, and the tent of the testimony and all its utensils, and the altar of incense,
verses.30:28: and the altar of whole burnt offerings and all its utensils, and the table and all its utensils, and the basin.
verses.30:29: And you shall sanctify them, and they shall be holy of holies; everyone who touches them shall be sanctified.
verses.30:30: And you shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and you shall sanctify them to serve as priests to Me.
verses.30:31: And to the sons of Israel you shall speak, saying, 'This shall be to you a holy oil, an ointment of anointing, throughout your generations.
verses.30:32: On human flesh it shall not be anointed, and according to this composition it shall not be made for yourselves in the same way; it is holy, and it shall be a holy thing to you.
verses.30:33: Whoever makes one in the same way, and whoever gives any of it to an outsider, shall be utterly destroyed from his people.'"
verses.30:34: And the Lord said to Moses, "Take for yourself spices: stacte, onycha, fragrant galbanum, and translucent frankincense; it shall be equal part for equal part;
verses.30:35: and they shall make with it a perfumed incense, the work of a perfumer, blended, a pure, holy work.
verses.30:36: And you shall crush some of these finely, and you shall place it in front of the testimonies in the tent of the testimony, where I will make Myself known to you from there; it shall be a holy of holies to you.
verses.30:37: Incense according to this composition you shall not make for yourselves; it shall be to you a holy thing for the Lord.
verses.30:38: Whoever makes it in the same way so as to smell it shall perish from his people."
verses.31:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.31:2: "Look, I have called by name Bezalel, the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,
verses.31:3: and I have filled him with a divine spirit of wisdom and understanding and knowledge in every work,
verses.31:4: to devise and to design, to work gold and silver and bronze, and blue and purple and spun scarlet,
verses.31:5: and stonework, and for the carpentry works of wood, to work according to all the works.
verses.31:6: And I have given him and Eliab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, and to everyone understanding in heart I have given understanding;
verses.31:7: and they shall make all that I have commanded you: the tent of the testimony, and the ark of the covenant and the mercy seat that is on it, and the furnishings of the tent,
verses.31:8: and the altars, and the table and all its utensils, and the pure lampstand and all its utensils,
verses.31:9: and the basin and its base,
verses.31:10: and the ministry robes of Aaron and the robes of his sons, to serve as priests to Me,
verses.31:11: and the oil of anointing, and the incense of the composition of the sanctuary; according to all that I have commanded you, they shall make them."
verses.31:12: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.31:13: "And you, command the sons of Israel, saying, 'See to it and keep My Sabbaths; it is a sign with Me and among you throughout your generations, so that you may know that I am the Lord who sanctifies you.
verses.31:14: And you shall keep the Sabbaths, for this is a holy thing of the Lord for you; the one who profanes it shall surely be put to death; everyone who does work on it, that soul shall be utterly destroyed from the midst of his people.
verses.31:15: Six days you shall do work, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath, a holy rest to the Lord; everyone who does work on the seventh day shall be put to death.
verses.31:16: And the sons of Israel shall keep the Sabbaths, to observe them throughout their generations;
verses.31:17: an eternal covenant between Me and the sons of Israel, it is an eternal sign with Me; for in six days the Lord made the heaven and the earth, and on the seventh day He rested and ceased.'"
verses.31:18: And He gave to Moses, when He finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, the two tablets of the testimony, stone tablets written with the finger of God.
verses.32:1: And when the people saw that Moses had delayed to come down from the mountain, the people gathered together against Aaron and said to him, "Rise up and make for us gods who will go before us; for this Moses, the man who brought us out of Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him."
verses.32:2: And Aaron said to them, "Take off the gold earrings that are in the ears of your wives and daughters, and bring them to me."
verses.32:3: And all the people took off the gold earrings that were in their ears, and brought them to Aaron.
verses.32:4: And he received them from their hands and formed them with the engraving tool, and made them into a cast calf, and he said, "These are your gods, Israel, who brought you up from the land of Egypt."
verses.32:5: And when Aaron saw this, he built an altar in front of it; and Aaron made a proclamation, saying, "Tomorrow is a festival of the Lord."
verses.32:6: And rising early on the next day, he offered up whole burnt offerings and presented a sacrifice of deliverance; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and they rose up to play.
verses.32:7: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, "Go quickly from here, go down; for your people, whom you brought out from the land of Egypt, have acted lawlessly.
verses.32:8: They have turned aside quickly from the way that you commanded them; they have made for themselves a calf, and they have worshiped it and said, 'These are your gods, Israel, who brought you up from the land of Egypt.'
verses.32:10: And now leave Me alone, and becoming furious with anger against them, I will wipe them out, and I will make you into a great nation."
verses.32:11: And Moses pleaded before the Lord God and said, "Why, Lord, are You furious with anger against Your people, whom You brought out from the land of Egypt with great strength and with Your uplifted arm?
verses.32:12: Do not let the Egyptians speak, saying, 'With evil intent He brought them out to kill them in the mountains and to consume them from the earth.' Cease from the anger of Your fury, and be merciful concerning the wickedness of Your people,
verses.32:13: remembering Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, Your household servants, to whom You swore by Yourself and spoke to them, saying, 'I will greatly multiply your offspring like the stars of heaven in multitude,' and all this land that You spoke of giving to them, and they will possess it forever."
verses.32:14: And the Lord was appeased so as to preserve His people.
verses.32:15: And Moses turned and went down from the mountain; and the two tablets of the testimony were in his hands, stone tablets, inscribed on both of their sides; on this side and on that side they were written.
verses.32:16: And the tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.
verses.32:17: And when Joshua heard the sound of the people shouting, he said to Moses, "There is a sound of war in the camp."
verses.32:18: And he said, "It is not the sound of those leading off in strength, nor the sound of those leading off in defeat; rather, it is the sound of those leading off with wine that I hear."
verses.32:19: And when he drew near to the camp, he saw the calf and the dances; and becoming angry with fury, Moses threw the two tablets from his hands and shattered them beneath the mountain.
verses.32:20: And taking the calf that they had made, he burned it up in fire, and ground it fine, and scattered it under the water, and made the sons of Israel drink it.
verses.32:21: And Moses said to Aaron, "What did this people do to you, that you brought a great sin upon them?"
verses.32:22: And Aaron said to Moses, "Do not be angry, lord; for you know the impulse of this people.
verses.32:23: For they said to me, 'Make for us gods who will go before us; for this Moses, the man who brought us out of Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him.'
verses.32:24: And I said to them, 'If anyone has gold jewelry, take it off.' And they gave it to me; and I threw it into the fire, and this calf came out."
verses.32:25: And when Moses saw that the people had been scattered--for Aaron had scattered them, an object of gloating to their adversaries--
verses.32:26: Moses stood at the gate of the camp and said, "Who is for the Lord? Let him come to me." So all the sons of Levi came together.
verses.32:27: And he said to them, "Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel: 'Each of you, put his own sword on his thigh, and pass through and return from gate to gate through the camp, and kill, each one his brother and each one his nearest neighbor.'"
verses.32:28: And the sons of Levi did just as Moses spoke to them; and there fell from the people on that day about three thousand men.
verses.32:29: And Moses said to them, "You have filled your hands today for the Lord, each one against his son or his brother, so that a blessing may be given upon you."
verses.32:30: And it happened after the next day that Moses said to the people, "You have sinned a great sin. And now I will go up to God, so that I may make atonement for your sin."
verses.32:31: So Moses returned to the Lord and said, "I implore You, Lord; this people has sinned a great sin, and they have made for themselves gods of gold.
verses.32:32: And now, if You forgive them their sin, forgive it; but if not, blot me out from Your book that You have written."
verses.32:33: And the Lord said to Moses, "If anyone has sinned, I will blot them out from My book.
verses.32:34: But you, go, go down, and lead this people into the place that I told you; look, My angel goes before your face; and on whatever day I visit, I will bring their sin upon them."
verses.32:35: And the Lord struck the people because of the making of the calf that Aaron had made.
verses.33:1: And the Lord said to Moses, "Go, go up from here, you and your people whom you brought out from the land of Egypt, into the land that I swore to Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, saying, 'To your offspring I will give it.'
verses.33:2: And I will send My angel along before your face, and you will drive out the Amorite and the Hittite and the Perizzite and the Girgashite and the Hivite and the Jebusite.
verses.33:3: And I will bring you into a land flowing with milk and honey; for I will certainly not go up with you, because you are a stiff-necked people, so that I may not consume you on the way."
verses.33:4: And when the people heard this bad word, they mourned deeply in mourning garments.
verses.33:5: And the Lord said to the sons of Israel, "You are a stiff-necked people; watch out that I do not bring another plague upon you and consume you. Now therefore, take off the robes of your glories and your adornment, and I will show you what I will do to you."
verses.33:6: And the sons of Israel took off their adornment and their attire from Mount Horeb.
verses.33:7: And Moses took his tent and pitched it outside the camp, far away from the camp, and it was called the tent of testimony; and it happened that everyone who sought the Lord would go out to the tent outside the camp.
verses.33:8: And whenever Moses went into the tent outside the camp, all the people would stand watching, each one beside the doors of his tent; and they would observe Moses as he departed until he entered into the tent.
verses.33:9: And whenever Moses entered into the tent, the pillar of the cloud would come down and stand at the door of the tent, and He would speak to Moses.
verses.33:10: And all the people would see the pillar of the cloud standing at the door of the tent; and all the people, standing up, would worship, each one from the door of his tent.
verses.33:11: And the Lord spoke to Moses face to face, as if someone should speak to his own friend. And he would return to the camp; but the attendant Joshua, son of Nun, a young man, would not depart from the tent.
verses.33:12: And Moses said to the Lord, "Look, You say to me, 'Lead this people up,' yet You have not made known to me whom You will send along with me; and You have said to me, 'I know you above all, and you have favor with Me.'
verses.33:13: Therefore, if I have found favor before You, reveal Yourself to me; let me see You clearly, so that I may have found favor before You, and so that I may know that this great nation is Your people."
verses.33:14: And He said, "I Myself will go before you and will give you rest."
verses.33:15: And he said to Him, "If You Yourself do not go, do not lead me up from here.
verses.33:16: And how will it truly be known that I have found favor with You, both I and Your people, except by Your going along with us? And both I and Your people will be glorified beyond all the nations that are on the earth."
verses.33:17: And the Lord said to Moses, "This word also that you have spoken I will do for you; for you have found favor before Me, and I know you above all."
verses.33:18: And he said, "Reveal Yourself to me."
verses.33:19: And He said, "I will pass by before you in My glory, and I will speak by My name, 'the Lord,' before you; and I will have mercy on whomever I have mercy, and I will show compassion to whomever I show compassion."
verses.33:20: And He said, "You will not be able to see My face; for no human being will see My face and live."
verses.33:21: And the Lord said, "Look, there is a place beside Me; you will stand on the rock.
verses.33:22: And when My glory passes by, then I will place you into a cleft of the rock, and I will cover over you with My hand until I have passed by.
verses.33:23: And I will take away My hand, and then you will see My back, but My face will not be seen by you."
verses.34:1: And the Lord said to Moses, "Chisel for yourself two stone tablets just like the first ones, and come up to Me onto the mountain, and I will write upon the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you shattered.
verses.34:2: And be ready for the morning, and you shall go up onto Mount Sinai, and stand before Me there on the top of the mountain.
verses.34:3: And let no one go up with you, nor be seen anywhere on the whole mountain; and let the sheep and the cattle not graze near that mountain."
verses.34:4: And he chiseled two stone tablets just like the first ones; and rising early in the morning, Moses went up onto Mount Sinai, just as the Lord had commanded him; and Moses took the two stone tablets.
verses.34:5: And the Lord came down in a cloud and stood beside him there, and called by the name of the Lord.
verses.34:6: And the Lord passed by before his face, and called out, "The Lord God, compassionate and merciful, slow to anger and abounding in mercy and true,
verses.34:7: and keeping righteousness and mercy to thousands, taking away lawless deeds and injustices and sins, and He will not acquit the guilty, bringing the lawless deeds of fathers upon children and upon children's children, to the third and fourth generation."
verses.34:8: And hurrying, Moses bowed down to the ground and worshiped,
verses.34:9: and he said, "If I have found favor before You, let my Lord go along with us; for the people are stiff-necked, and You will take away our sins and our lawless deeds, and we will be Yours."
verses.34:10: And the Lord said to Moses, "Look, I am making a covenant with you before all your people; I will do glorious things that have not happened in all the earth and in any nation; and all the people among whom you are will see the works of the Lord, for the things that I will do for you are marvelous.
verses.34:11: Pay attention to all that I am commanding you; look, I am driving out before your face the Amorite and the Canaanite and the Perizzite and the Hittite and the Hivite and the Girgashite and the Jebusite.
verses.34:12: Watch yourself, so that you never make a covenant with those dwelling on the land into which you are entering, so that it does not become a stumbling block to you among you.
verses.34:13: You shall tear down their altars, and you shall shatter their pillars, and you shall cut down their groves, and you shall burn up the carved images of their gods with fire.
verses.34:14: For you shall by no means worship other gods; for the Lord God, a jealous name, is a jealous God.
verses.34:15: Never make a covenant with those dwelling among foreigners on the land, or else they will prostitute themselves after their gods, and sacrifice to their gods, and invite you and you eat from their sacrifices,
verses.34:16: and you take some of their daughters for your sons, and give some of your daughters to their sons, and your daughters prostitute themselves after their gods, and your sons prostitute themselves after their gods.
verses.34:17: And you shall not make molten gods for yourself.
verses.34:18: And you shall keep the Festival of Unleavened Bread; for seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, just as I have commanded you, at the appointed time in the month of new things; for in the month of new things you came out of Egypt.
verses.34:19: Everything that opens the womb—the males are Mine, every firstborn of a calf and firstborn of a sheep.
verses.34:20: And the firstborn of a beast of burden you shall redeem with a sheep; but if you do not redeem it, you shall pay a price. Every firstborn of your sons you shall redeem; you shall not appear before Me empty-handed.
verses.34:21: Six days you shall work, but on the seventh there is rest; during sowing and during harvesting, there is rest.
verses.34:22: And you shall observe a Festival of Weeks for Me, the beginning of the wheat harvest, and the beginning of the ingathering in the middle of the year.
verses.34:23: Three times of the year every male of yours shall appear before the Lord, the God of Israel.
verses.34:24: For when I drive out the nations before your face and enlarge your borders, no one will covet your land whenever you go up to appear before the Lord your God three times of the year.
verses.34:25: You shall not slaughter the blood of My incense offerings with leaven, and the sacrifices of the Festival of the Passover shall not remain overnight until the morning.
verses.34:26: The firstfruits of your land you shall place in the house of the Lord your God. You shall not offer a lamb in its mother's milk."
verses.34:27: And the Lord said to Moses, "Write for yourself these words; for on the basis of these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel."
verses.34:28: And Moses was there before the Lord forty days and forty nights; he did not eat bread and he did not drink water; and he wrote these words upon the tablets of the covenant, the ten words.
verses.34:29: Now as Moses was coming down from the mountain, the two tablets were in the hands of Moses; and as he was coming down from the mountain, Moses did not know that the appearance of the complexion of his face had been glorified while he was speaking to Him.
verses.34:30: And Aaron and all the elders of Israel saw Moses, and the appearance of the complexion of his face was glorified. And they were afraid to come near him.
verses.34:31: And Moses called them, and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation turned back to him; and Moses spoke to them.
verses.34:32: And after this all the sons of Israel came near to him. And he commanded them all that the Lord had commanded him on Mount Sinai.
verses.34:33: And when he finished speaking to them, he put a veil over his face.
verses.34:34: But whenever Moses would go in before the Lord to speak to Him, he would take off the veil until he came out; and having come out, he would speak to all the sons of Israel whatever the Lord had commanded him.
verses.34:35: And the sons of Israel saw the face of Moses, that it was glorified; and Moses put a veil over his face until he should go in to speak with Him.
verses.35:1: And Moses gathered together all the congregation of the sons of Israel and said, "These are the words that the Lord spoke, to do them:
verses.35:2: Six days you shall do works, but on the seventh day there is rest—a holy thing, a Sabbath, a rest to the Lord; everyone who does work on it shall die.
verses.35:3: You shall not kindle a fire in any dwelling of yours on the day of the Sabbaths; I am the Lord."
verses.35:4: And Moses spoke to all the congregation of the sons of Israel, saying, "This is the word that the Lord commanded, saying,
verses.35:5: 'Take from among yourselves a contribution for the Lord; everyone who is willing in heart shall bring the firstfruits to the Lord: gold, silver, bronze,
verses.35:6: blue, purple, double-dyed spun scarlet, twisted fine linen, and goat hair,
verses.35:7: and ram skins dyed red, and blue-dyed skins, and rot-resistant wood,
verses.35:9: and sardius stones and stones for engraving for the ephod and the full-length robe.
verses.35:10: And let everyone wise in heart among you come and make all that the Lord has commanded:
verses.35:11: the tabernacle and the coverings and the crossbars and the bars and the pillars,
verses.35:12: and the ark of the testimony and its carrying poles and its mercy seat and the curtain, and the hangings of the courtyard and its pillars, and the emerald stones, and the incense, and the anointing oil,
verses.35:13: and the table and all its utensils,
verses.35:14: and the lampstand of light and all its utensils,
verses.35:16: and the altar and all its utensils,
verses.35:19: and the holy robes of Aaron the priest, and the robes in which they will minister, and the tunics of the priesthood for the sons of Aaron, and the anointing oil, and the compounded incense.'"
verses.35:20: And all the congregation of the sons of Israel went out from Moses.
verses.35:21: And they brought up—each one whose heart moved them, and all to whose soul it seemed good—a contribution; and they brought a contribution to the Lord for all the works of the tabernacle of the testimony and for all its workmanship and for all the robes of the sanctuary.
verses.35:22: And the men brought from the women—everyone to whose mind it seemed good brought signet rings and earrings and finger rings and hair clasps and armlets, every gold article;
verses.35:23: and all those who brought contributions of gold to the Lord. And everyone with whom fine linen and blue-dyed skins and ram skins dyed red were found brought them.
verses.35:24: And everyone setting apart the contribution brought silver and bronze, the contributions to the Lord; and those with whom rot-resistant wood was found brought it for all the works of the construction.
verses.35:25: And every woman wise in mind to spin with her hands brought spun goods: the blue and the purple and the scarlet and the fine linen;
verses.35:26: and all the women to whose mind it seemed good in wisdom spun the goat hair.
